items.heading: Himachali Dham
details: Key ingredients: rice, rajma or black chickpeas, yogurt curry, ghee
Cook rice and a lentil or bean dish separately with warming spices.
Prepare a smooth yogurt-based curry called madra.
Arrange all the dishes together on a large leaf plate.
Serve as a full festive meal, traditionally at community feasts.

items.heading: Himachali Trout Curry
details: Key ingredients: trout fish, yogurt, mustard oil, whole spices, ginger
Lightly shallow-fry trout pieces in mustard oil and set aside.
Prepare a yogurt-based gravy with ginger and whole spices.
Slide the fried fish into the simmering gravy.
Cook gently for a few minutes so the fish absorbs the flavor without breaking.

items.heading: Bal Mithai
details: Key ingredients: roasted khoya (milk solids), sugar, white sugar balls
Roast khoya slowly until it turns a deep brown and develops a nutty aroma.
Mix in sugar and cook until it forms a fudgy, slightly grainy mass.
Shape into small squares while still warm.
Coat generously in small white sugar balls before it fully sets.

items.heading: Garhwali Chicken Curry
details: Key ingredients: chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, whole spices
Saute onion until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste and whole spices.
Add chicken pieces and sear until sealed.
Add a little water and simmer, covered, until the chicken is tender.
Cook until the gravy thickens and coats the chicken well.
